fields.System.Title: INT-104 — Handle malformed messages
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want unprocessable messages stored rather than dropped, so that the
ERP never believes in an order the WMS has no record of.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a message that fails parsing or validation, then it is stored in a dead-letter
  • table with its original payload, the error, and the timestamp.
  • - Given a dead-letter entry, then it is never silently deleted.
  • - Given the dead-letter table, then it can be listed and filtered, and someone reviews
  • it daily.
  • - Given a corrected underlying problem, then a dead-lettered message can be replayed.
  • - Given replay, then it is idempotent — replaying a message already processed changes
  • nothing.
  • - Given dead-letter volume above a threshold, then an alert is raised.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | dead-letter |
| Risks | Silent message drop ([doc 08 §6](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency |
